name: Asou Nao
source:
Currently a second year in middle school. Quiet and unwilling to get close to people. He stopped attending school because of bullying. When he reached the point of thinking that he wanted to die, he happened to find a message on a certain suicide site...

(from the [url=http://mintwings.web.fc2.com/m05/character.html]official site[/url])
